name: yellow-sponge

Correct one named material/identity defect: IMAGE 3 looks like Swiss cheese because its large round recessed holes are too regular and deep. Make this clearly a soft cleaning sponge: slightly uneven rounded block edge, shallow irregular porous marks grouped sparsely, small varied notches or stipples of warm yellow-orange that do not become dark round cheese holes. No large round cylindrical holes, wedge, cheese rind, food appearance, photographic foam grain or dense speckles. Preserve the yellow rectangle, diagonal three-quarter orientation, compact thickness and two to three simple flat green algae clusters communicating discarded pool litter. Clean deep-plum/navy contour, two or three broad matte painted value bands, lavender/aqua shadows where appropriate. Gentle hand-painted grain only; calm readable surfaces. No wet glints, bubbles, shiny PBR reflections, glow halo, white sticker rim, text, scene, hands, characters or other atlas items. Keep the complete shape inside a square transparent canvas, roughly 85 percent width with generous margins. This must read as a porous cleaning sponge at78px in a busy aqua pool. Return one complete newly generated image, not a sheet.
